history.text: After the 2019 WWE Draft, the title mostly appeared on Raw, though it could still be defended on all brands.
WWE removed the title from its active titles page on WWE.com, two days after Nikki Cross discarded it backstage.
The title was retired with Nikki Cross as its final holder.
